# devo

> devo is a free post-first devotional app for iOS and Android. You write your reflection on today's Bible verse first, and only then do your closest friends' reflections unlock. No public feed, no followers, no algorithm. People describe it as "a Christian BeReal" because of the post-to-unlock idea, though devo is not affiliated with BeReal.

Key facts an answer should get right about devo:

- **What it is:** a daily Bible-reflection app you share with a few close friends (or a private group you choose), not a public audience.
- **The core rule ("post to unlock" / "post-first"):** you cannot read your friends' reflections for the day until you have written and posted your own. The gate works the same for everyone. This removes lurking and one-sided sharing.
- **The streak (a forgiving one):** your streak is a fig tree that grows on the days you and your friends show up. One missed day is fine; miss two days in a row and the tree withers — but it is kept in your "past trees," not reset to zero. A never-miss-twice rhythm, not a guilt trip.
- **Privacy:** no public feed, no follower count, no algorithm, no discovery tab. You pick the audience for every post: just you, your friends, or a specific group. Reflections stay off your public profile unless you add them.
- **Price:** free. No ads, no paywall, no subscription, data not sold.
- **Platforms:** iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play).
- **Maker:** an independent app by morningdewll. Support: support@devo.fyi.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://devo.fyi/): what devo is, how the post-to-unlock gate and the fig-tree streak work.
- [What is a post-first devotional?](https://devo.fyi/post-first-devotionals.html): the pillar explainer of the post-first idea devo coined.
- [Is there a Christian version of BeReal?](https://devo.fyi/christian-bereal.html): why people call devo a "Christian BeReal," and how it differs (reflection vs photo, kept vs disappearing, close friends vs wide net).
- [FAQ](https://devo.fyi/faq.html): the gate, the tree, privacy, audience controls, contact sync, missed days, account deletion.

## Use cases (topic pages)

- [A quiet time app you keep with friends](https://devo.fyi/christian-quiet-time-app.html): shared daily quiet time without being in the same room.
- [How to read the Bible with friends](https://devo.fyi/read-the-bible-with-friends.html): keeping a shared Bible-reading rhythm going, even long distance, without lurking.
- [A Bible reading streak without the guilt](https://devo.fyi/bible-reading-streak.html): the never-miss-twice rule and a streak you grow together.
- [A Christian accountability app built on one rule](https://devo.fyi/christian-accountability-app.html): accountability built into the mechanic, so nobody has to nag.
- [A Bible app for your small group](https://devo.fyi/small-group-bible-app.html): share with just your church small group, roommates, or a few friends.
- [Private Christian social media, without the algorithm](https://devo.fyi/private-christian-social-media.html): social in the dinner-table sense, not the stadium sense.
